normative_extracts.quote: When a node is inert, user agent ignore input events, focusability, find-in-page, and accessibility tree exposure for that node.

engine_internals.mechanism_summary: The HTML inert attribute instructs the engine to suppress pointer events, keyboard focus, text selection, find-in-page, and accessibility tree nodes for an entire subtree.

production_failures.symptom: Keyboard users tab into hidden off-screen drawer links while aria-hidden='true' is set
production_failures.root_cause: aria-hidden='true' hides elements from screen readers but leaves buttons and links in the keyboard Tab order and clickable.
production_failures.mitigation: Replace aria-hidden='true' + tabindex='-1' hacks with the native inert attribute on collapsed drawers and background shells.

production_failures.symptom: Accidental inert on ancestor locks out the open modal itself
production_failures.root_cause: Placing inert on <body> or a shared wrapper that also contains the active modal makes the modal unclickable.
production_failures.mitigation: Mount the modal in a sibling subtree or use <dialog>.showModal() which automatically makes everything outside the Top Layer inert.
